notes.title: Patch Notes - Jan 12, 2020
notes.content:
Update scheduled: Jan 12th, 2020, 23pm PST

[h1]Updated Contents[/h1]
1. Updated some furniture icons.
2. Updated some models of high-level furniture.
3. Added some new models of the dungeon maps.
4. Updated the model of the campsites.
5. Added some new models of the blocks in the world map.
6. Added some new models of the environmental items in the manor.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Jan 7, 2019
notes.content:
Update scheduled: Jan 7th, 2019, 23pm PST

[h1]Updated Content[/h1]
1. Fixed an issue that caused the continuous low frame rate when you survive more than 300 days.
2. Fixed the incorrect good energy gain after the Level 3 Monster Tower has been built up.
3. Fixed the incorrect disappearance of the herbivores and carnivores during the special event herbivores/carnivores invade.
4. Fixed the incorrect display of the secondary interfaces in the world when using ESC.
5. Fixed the absence of the animal special effects in the animal raising interface.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Dec 27 2019
notes.content:
Update scheduled: [b]Dec 27th, 2019, 0:00am[/b] PST

[h1]New Content[/h1]
Added a Learning Mode.

[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
1. You may now move the screen using the mouse.
2. The work you are currently doing is shown on the top right corner of the screen.
3. You may now switch characters using hotkeys F1-F7.
4. Adjust the language selecting icon and function on the title screen.
5. Updated the BGM: character creating screen, manor-night, world-daytime, and combat.
6. Removed the movement confirmation in dungeons.
7. Added the QQ group and Twitter information on the title screen.
8. Adjusted the rule of triggering debuffs in the world. Debuffs can be triggered only when a character walks more than 24 blocks on the same landform. Once the character entered a different landform, went back to the manor, or triggered a debuff, the counting of the movement will be reset.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
1. Fixed the incorrect moving issues in the world.
2. Fixed the incorrect BGM repeating point.
3. Fixed the incorrect UI display at the edges of the world and dungeons.

notes.title: 《妖师》中怎么样才能活得长久？
notes.content:
高考：“做题的时候首先要想出题人的意图。” 
考生：“他想让我死。”
妖师：“行动之前要仔细考虑下策划的意图。”
我：“直说吧，他不就是想让我死吗？”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/2a58d656fccf39cee6a98b1d4f2f152677e08f5d.png[/img]

12月20日在Steam上线的游戏《妖师》真是我本年度见过最“恶意满满”的游戏，101遍读档高歌“只不过是从头再来”后我不得不吐槽下《妖师》策划的良心真是大大的坏了！
游戏中角色的三项指标“饱食”、“情绪”、“精力”任意一项归0你就会狗带，底部的灵力值归0世界就崩塌，你当然还是会死，生命值归0呢？毫无疑问就是死......

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/cca8cb6b19cb4d5f78cee6a4edfdb6ca73374a2f.jpg[/img]

那么究竟怎样才能在《妖师》中活的长久呢？
请注意，以下皆是我满是血泪的经验之谈，一家之言，或有片面，多多包涵。
1. “情绪”可以通过看电视恢复，“精力”白天睡沙发晚上睡床都可以恢复，唯有“饱食”一项必须消耗食物才能恢复，而食物则需要你种植/养殖获得原材料、研发出食物配方、在料理台上烹饪后才能获得，当接近饿死的时候才想到去种地是绝对不行的，所以最重要的一点就是做好食物储备，屯压缩饼干性价比最高。（偷偷告诉你，实在来不及做食物的时候，可以直接啃食材）

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/a72b98be2ed4512744b0b6c10e1fe28a69769b3b.png[/img]

2. 游戏初期必须做的几件事：开地种小麦；养鸡；研究出馒头、肯德基、安眠药的配方；在珍奇百货商来的时候买几个冬虫夏草。

3. 家里食物不足了而养的妖灵又太能吃怎么办？指望它们“嘴下留情”是不现实的，偷偷地将一部分食物藏到背包中才是正解。为了活下去，“吃独食”也是可以的嘛。

4. 上一条同样可以作为家中长期未打扫出现“垃圾如山”状态后无法进食，饱食又即将归0时的应急方案，背包中带着食物出门，在野外吃完后再回家打扫，以免饿死于打扫中途。

5. 做手工和睡觉的时候，角色饱食降到红线有可能也不去吃饭，如果不手动让他去吃饭会活活饿死。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/3ab934617893456e5387f222d72607ff4ed263d8.png[/img]

6. 一定要学会手动存档！读档，又被称作SL大法，作为单机游戏中无往不利的绝技，特别好用！想要妖灵满技能？卡在最后一次驯化前存档；想要挽回“熊孩子”、“原始人”等事件的损失？睡前存档；打大妖前不知道怼不怼的过？保险起见存个档......

7. 一天的时间就那么长，但要做的事情却那么多，怎么办？必须多养几只妖灵（苦力）。种植、养殖、采矿、研发、料理、打扫，这些事情都能交给妖灵来做，你的主要精力必须花费在手工上。手工等级高，遇到3级事件时才能打造出高级的道具解决；才能做出更牛逼的武器、防具、法宝，在外冒险更安全；才能做出高级床、高级餐桌等高级家具，节约时间。

8. 出门冒险必带清单：食物、果子饮、回血药、火把/篝火/帐篷、备用武器、身上穿戴武器防具法宝。还有记得预留回城所需的食物、饮料、帐篷、药品，遇到驿站后一定要买传送卷轴。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/9d07468df33679df96872ec0fa063dc76afc163c.png[/img]

9. 野外的地块事件，饱食、情绪之类，初始角色运气值低的千万不要踩，可以等作出增加运气的法宝后再去试试，否则被扣掉一大截数值可能会直接GAME OVER。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/9d07468df33679df96872ec0fa063dc76afc163c.png[/img]

不说了，《妖师》中的坑真是数不胜数。我只能说，有些坑，掉着掉着你就习惯了......还得自己亲身体验一下才会明白。
唉，谁能想到这么一款以建造镇妖塔为终极目标的游戏，在达成目标前最大的拦路虎，居然不是青龙白虎朱雀玄武四大boss，而是烦恼怎么活下去吗？怪不得游戏标签是“生存冒险”，果然生存才是重头戏吗？是我输了......

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/8a2a870770cbea4f10eff15b432eb4e1c44e00e5.png[/img]

《妖师》微信公众号：妖师ElfManor

notes.title: Elf Manor Gameplay Instruction
notes.content:
[h1]Title Screen[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/7d05984ff8d5d20cd28cbf6952f7d52afbf5ae3a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Language[/h1]
You may change the language at the bottom right corner in the title screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/b65435d320613d7c8db518a489ddd8a393e50645.jpg[/img]

[h1]Continue[/h1]
Click “Continue” to play the last save you had played.

[h1]New Game[/h1]
Select Mode
There are Building Mode and Challenge Mode you can choose to play. Building mode is easier than challenge mode, but it’s still challengeable for a newbie.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/7bdacae672cb63b01e51b3cb5396ad22e9dd6838.jpg[/img]

[h1]Create a character[/h1]
Nickname: enter a nickname for your avatar.
Talents: roll your talents. The weapons, armors, and some other items you equipped depend on your talents.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/be11ec47044a70e1ce30062632d03011779fb5b8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Load Game[/h1] 
You can choose the save files you played before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/ecd8ca64e25dc3fb5e67af4463a5d7f3d60878e4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Options[/h1]
Adjust the settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/83accfd57f6db628c79ff9184ca31e136bb79af4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Enter the game[/h1]
The first time you enter the game, you are nobody. You are weak and lack of resources. The only thing you have to remember is staying alive. Your mission is to grow up and build the Monster Tower.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/d89f30551b0e4ba9bf3ec8d585425c4a80b5ed8c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Move the camera[/h1]
Press WASD to move the camera.
W→up
A→left
S→down
D→right

[h1]Pause and Accelerate[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/cbcf6e732f17dea3eefab8a2aef42598e98bb05a.jpg[/img]
You may control the speed of the game at the bottom-right corner on the screen.
Pause: pause the game. Hotkey [space].
X1 Speed: the standard speed of the game. Hotkey [1].
X4 Speed: 4 times the standard speed. Hotkey [2]
X8 Speed: 8 times the standard speed. Hotkey [3]
X16 Speed: 16 times the standard speed. Hotkey [4]. The icon is not shown on the screen. Please use X16 Speed wisely.
X32 Speed: 32 times the standard speed. Hotkey [5]. The icon is not shown on the screen. Please use X32 Speed wisely.

[h1]Select a character[/h1]
Left click the portrait of the character or your elf to select the individual. Then you have control over the individual.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/ff304d8c8699355345490c3d173cfa85f6f0eaa0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Resources Display[/h1]
The items, materials, foods, etc. you have obtained are shown in your bag and inventory. The resource list on the left of the screen gives you a quick look to all resources.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/620404bb1de9c5201dbe7d4d988010b3e8711dcc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Profile[/h1]
Select an individual and click the portrait on the bottom left to open the profile. It shows all the attributes of the individual.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/dc08eb0494a7fd6bb099c014b61c458b953e8f87.jpg[/img]

[h1]Use an item[/h1]
Select an item in your bag or inventory, the options will be shown under the item. You may use or discard the item, or move them between bag and inventory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/6037e4abbe3390bde4d210911d9c73969e378ff9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Do it now[/h1]
Right click the furniture or land you can interact with to select “do it now”, then the character will do the work you selected first.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/fcf71a5f921cce43da51d875c0a99a992434fe71.jpg[/img]

[h1]Priority[/h1]
You may adjust the priority list at the top right corner to decide the works you are willing to do first. “1” gives the work the highest priority, empty means do not do it. The order of the works doesn’t influence the priority.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/d80e8ca67774c7b5ed9087f2e3817003650cec78.jpg[/img]

[h1]The three indices[/h1]
The three indices are hunger, emotion, and energy. All the works you do will consume the three indices. Once you have run out of any one of them, you will die!
Hunger: having meals at the dining table recovers your hunger.
Emotion: treadmill and TV recover your emotion.
Energy: sleeping in bed or couch recover your energy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/8741d1ae58e06aa2b0067f2041b3ba0a9b62c08f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Good Energy/Evil Energy[/h1]
Evil energy and good energy are opposite to each other. Evil energy increases with time and suppresses good energy at the same time. The whole world will be filled with evil energy once the good energy turns to zero, as a result, the world will collapse, and the game is over. Good energy and evil energy are displayed at the bottom of the screen. Killing evil monsters can reduce the evil energy of the world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/412a0e2968188c1c86af10d7d2aba7529c4f40ff.jpg[/img]

[h1]Farm crops and raise animals[/h1]
When you first time enters the game, all you can do is to farm crops and raise animals. Both of the works can provide the necessary survival materials to you. You will obtain resources like vegetables, eggs, milk, and meat, etc. This is also the basis of all game activities. Then you can handcraft foods, equipment, items, and medicines using raw materials. 
You may left click a piece of empty land and drag a type of crops or animals onto the land to start farming. Then the character will do the works according to the priority you set.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/364c4a19eb346898beab80db9220ac919a17275d.jpg[/img]
You may right click a piece of land to set up how you want to treat a mature land. Harvest fruits or cut down the tree, collect eggs, milk, wool, or butcher livestock.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/b02a741724379840760f11189a64eb11dab7a907.jpg[/img]

[h1]Research[/h1]
You can research all kinds of technologies at the laboratory and then handcraft better food, medicine, furniture, weapon, armor, and special material. Different items have different properties which will give you different abilities.
Researching work will cost you a lot of time and the three indices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/11d699ffc5d1219902e7967126ce34d2c7f72d74.jpg[/img]

[h1]Cook[/h1]
Left click the kitchen to add recipes of foods and medicines to the to-do list.
You may adjust the value of the foods you want to cook. Then the character will do the works according to the priority you set.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/59d7e54ab6a9b161bc4e9f9914b673fc55497c75.jpg[/img]

[h1]Handcraft[/h1]
Left click the workshop (anvil) to add recipes of furniture, equipment, and items to the to-do list.
You may adjust the value you want to handcraft. Then the character will do the works according to the priority you set.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/f1816bd967e18684cd563fd4b6e650daf8605ce1.jpg[/img]
Click the “!” to select the materials you want to use to handcraft a piece of equipment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/6a43ae7c8c7f7ac9c1d8c1d548c29554d9155f6e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mine[/h1]
Whenever you collect resources from a mature land, there’s always a chance to find ores. The messages are listed on the right of the screen. You may click the messages to collect the ores.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/2eb8fc1668606b1b88085660eb2435aee369401b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hatch[/h1]
You may put the elf eggs in the nest to hatch it. You need to keep interacting with the nest to make the progress bar to grow. Once the progress bar is completed, you will get a baby elf.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/96a5a5a781164ba60dcb788c112dac114360363a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Train[/h1]
Baby elves don’t contribute anything to your manor. You have to keep training them until they grow up. They will obtain up to three random abilities when they grow up.

[h1]Abilities of the elves[/h1]
Click the elf portrait at the bottom left corner to open the elf interface. Elf interface shows the abilities (the works them can do) of each elf.
You may set the priorities of each elf’s work(s). 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/a0aa9904fe700ab40ac6792594b3c86d0a19c1f3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Events[/h1]
The negative events happen randomly and influence your lands or your character (elves). Once you encountered any event, the red alerts will be shown on the right of the screen.
Agricultural events: insect, drought, and malnutrition. You may research the corresponding recipes to deal with these events.
Individual events: insomnia and malnutrition. You may research the corresponding recipes to deal with these events.

[h1]The World[/h1]
You may click the “World” button on the right of the screen, then click “Ready” to enter the world.
The world is made up of hexagon blocks. Every time you move to another block consumes the three indices (hunger, emotion, and energy).
There are a lot of evil monsters and treasures waiting for you to explore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/1b646e4d2c3ce12172656780b3cf72ecef00c3d1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Move the camera[/h1]
The same as the manor, you may press WASD to move the camera in the world.
You may also rotate the camera in the world by holding the right mouse button.

[h1]Move[/h1]
You may click a block to walk your character there. The path shows the amount of the blocks you will walk through and the values of the three indices will be consumed.
Walking in the world is still dangerous even if you don’t fight with evil monsters. You will be affected by debuffs randomly.

[h1]Bag[/h1]
You may open your bag by clicking the portrait at the bottom left.

[h1]Monsters[/h1]
Once you encountered a monster, you may choose to fight or leave.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/a6f5facd7ca846b8b5ac0bd9d6a0dcd796914df7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
The combat is turn-based. The action order is shown on the top of the screen. You can use your abilities and items to defeat the monsters. Some elves also have the ability to fight.
You can left click the icon to cast a spell. There are some spells give you or your elves a buff, you may left click to choose a target, then cast the buff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/37e6f13f4b926930ddcebfd39bfad1ed2784567e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Combat Spells[/h1]
All the spells can be used in combat come from the weapons. The spells of a weapon generate randomly when you finish handcrafting it. Each equipment has durability, once the durability turned to zero, the equipment is broken and disappear. Unfortunately, there is no repairing technology left in the world anymore.
There are five tiers of the equipment: gray, green, blue, purple, and orange. The higher the tier, the better the attributes. Using rare materials to handcraft a piece of equipment usually gives you higher quality equipment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/3393d12d6e1740dd3cdd6863214f4a181c595583.jpg[/img]

Be prepared and enter the world of Elf Manor now!

notes.title: Elf Manor – Monster Tower Global Challenge Starts NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016750/d9d1e287e8c8db9956859c2ccd5c293ac69879eb.png[/img]

Hello Elf Masters,
Elf Manor is out now on Steam Early Access! At the same time, we introduce the Monster Tower Global Challenge to you. This challenge starts today (December 19th) and ends on [b]January 2nd, 2020, 10AM PST[/b].

[h1]Prize:[/h1]
[spoiler]Nintendo Switch x1[/spoiler]

[h1]How does it work?[/h1]
1. Finish building the Level 4 Monster Tower in any game mode.

2. Take a screenshot of the entire window, including the monster tower and the nickname of your character. (Steam default screenshot key F12)

3. Upload your screenshot to the “Screenshots” page of the Elf Manor Steam Community Hub. Please add a description “[Elf Manor – Monster Tower Global Challenge]” to the caption of your screenshot. PS: only the author can edit the caption; adding the description to comment will NOT be considered as a challenger.

4. The challenge ends on January 2nd, 2020, 10AM PST. Then the development team will collect the information of all the qualified screenshots and their uploaders (challengers). The screenshots will be collected according to the timestamps showed on Steam.

5. The development team will draw a lucky dog randomly from all the qualified challengers before January 10th. The prize is a Nintendo Switch. We are going to broadcast the entire lottery process on Steam, using Excel formula =rand(a,b) to ensure fairness and justice.

6. The development team will contact the winner to discuss the mailing details.

[h1]To be noted:[/h1]
1. All challengers please set your Steam profile to Public, we might verify your qualification.

2. Please do NOT use other players’ screenshots or tamper the screenshots. If found, you will be disqualified.

3. Please do NOT use other players’ save files or modify save files. If found, you will be disqualified.

4. GY Games reserves the right of final interpretation of Elf Manor – Monster Tower Global Challenge.

Good luck to you and happy gaming!

notes.title: 《妖师》对外测试活动开启！
notes.content:
亲爱的各位玩家：

国产Low Poly生存冒险类游戏《妖师》计划将于[b]北京时间2019年12月13日15:00[/b]正式开启STEAM版本对外测试。在经历了一段漫长的开发旅程后，由光宇游戏旗下巫师工作室独立制作的Low Poly风格项目《妖师》，终于能够与各位玩家见面了，在此，我们诚邀各位游戏爱好者共同品鉴这款创新型独立游戏，作为开发者我们希望能够与各位玩家站在平等的角度上，去研究、探讨游戏中的问题，评估、挖掘产品的潜能，分析、突破开发中的瓶颈，我们会重视并依据所有参与者的意见和反馈，完善《妖师》这款游戏产品，调整我们的开发模式，最终为大家推出并呈现出一款符合“中国口味”的Low Poly国产游戏产品，对此我们承诺为了国产游戏的崛起而不断挑战自身的极限，并情愿成为这条荣耀之路的基石，为此我们将勇往直前！
